title: Respond to a reviewer comment that needs one new reference

notes/reviews.md.ask: Please discuss it and cite it.

prompt: notes/reviews.md holds the reviews. Address Reviewer 2's comment 3 in the paper: add the discussion it asks for in the related-work section, in no more than two sentences, and cite the work properly. Then write a short response to that comment in notes/response.md that says what you changed and where. Do not change anything else.
